title: Vitess: vtgate static-auth users (the MySQL :15306 front door)
description: Runs `nexus acl vitess {list,grant,revoke}` against the vtgate static-auth file (vtgate_creds.json) on both vtgate nodes. vtgate does not proxy CREATE USER DDL, so the front-door credentials are managed in the static file + a vtgate reload.

observe.what: lists the static-auth users; nexus = the app/operator login at :15306
reporting added to vtgate_creds.json on BOTH vtgate nodes (+ restart); nexus preserved
reporting removed; only nexus remains (round-trip clean)

whatProves: VitessAdapter.AclAsync manages the vtgate static-auth users (the real MySQL credentials at :15306): list parses vtgate_creds.json; grant/revoke edit it on both vtgate nodes + restart nexus-vtgate, protecting the built-in nexus user.
